name: db-migrate
description: Create, apply, or rollback database migrations. Supports Prisma migrations and raw SQL. Verifies migration safety (no destructive operations without confirmation).

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: One of: create, apply, rollback, status.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Migration result: action, migrationName, appliedAt, status, rollbackAvailable.

failureConditions.signal: prisma migrate exits with non-zero code
migration SQL contains DROP TABLE or DROP COLUMN without confirmation
prisma migrate status shows drift between migrations and database
